name: Glycosaminoglycan synthesis, protein O-glycosylation and mucopolysaccharidosis degradation
rationale: Members cover proteoglycan/GAG chain synthesis, O-mannosyl/fucosyl/glucosyl glycosylation (dystroglycan, Notch, TSR) and their disorders; unlike the closest confusable it also contains lysosomal GAG degradation and the mucopolysaccharidoses, and unlike the others it lacks N-glycan, sialic acid and glycosphingolipid catabolism.

name: Phosphatidic acid-derived triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of phosphatidic acid, mono/diacylglycerol, triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine (CDP-choline) and their regulation, distinguishing it from lipolysis/lipid-droplet confusables and from the broader phospholipid remodelling/catabolism confusable.

qualifier: kinesin-driven vesicle and synaptic protein cargo
name: Kinesin-driven neuronal vesicle and synaptic protein transport
rationale: Members describe motor-based transport of dense core vesicles, synaptic vesicles, receptor complexes and presynaptic proteins along neuronal cytoskeleton including kinesins, whereas confusables centre on mitochondrial/organelle transport or tubulin modification.

qualifier: severing, barbed-end capping and polymerization control
name: Actin filament severing, capping and polymerization control
rationale: All members regulate actin filament length and turnover (severing, capping, depolymerization, polymerization, Arp2/3 nucleation, ruffles), distinguishing them from confusables about lamellipodia, crosslinking or filopodia.

qualifier: including N-glycan processing and fucosylated blood-group antigens
name: Proteoglycan, O- and N-glycan synthesis with fucosylated antigens
rationale: Members span GAG/proteoglycan synthesis, O-glycosylation, N-glycan processing, fucose metabolism, sialylation and ABO/Lewis antigens; confusables lack these and instead hold nucleotide-sugar transport and glycosphingolipid synthesis.

qualifier: aromatic, histidine, threonine and proline with tetrahydrobiopterin
name: Aromatic, histidine, threonine and proline amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine (with BH4 cofactor and phenylketonuria), histidine, threonine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate metabolism, whereas confusables centre on sulfur amino acids, serine, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor.

qualifier: outflow tract, second heart field and great arteries
name: Embryonic heart morphogenesis: outflow tract and great arteries
rationale: All members concern embryonic heart formation, and distinctively include second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch/pulmonary/coronary artery morphogenesis absent from confusables focused on myocardium, septa and valves.

name: Extracellular matrix proteolysis and plasminogen-mediated fibrinolysis
rationale: Members cover MMP activation, collagen/elastin degradation and plasminogen activation/fibrin clot dissolution with platelet and adhesion context, distinguishing it from hyaluronan-degradation and contact-activation/kallikrein confusables.

name: Inflammasome, interleukin-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR-driven inflammatory cytokine production (IL-1, IL-6, TNF, IL-12) and uniquely include NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes and IL-1 precursor processing, absent from TLR/TRIF-centred confusables.

core: Positive regulation of proinflammatory cytokine production
name: TLR3/TLR4-driven positive regulation of proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members positively regulate TLR3/TLR4 signaling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, lacking the inflammasome and negative-regulation members of the closest confusable and the TRIF/IKK machinery of others.

core: Nephric duct and ureteric bud development
qualifier: mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation
name: Mesonephric duct, ureteric bud and renal vesicle development
rationale: All members describe early urinary tract epithelial tube development; mesonephric duct, metanephric ureteric bud elongation and renal vesicle formation distinguish it from confusables on ureteric bud induction/branching and kidney size.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Members describe glucose catabolism through glycolysis to lactate and its regulation by fructose-2,6-bisphosphate and nucleotide catabolism, distinguishing it from FOXO/mTOR, hypoxia and creatine confusables.

qualifier: testis, germ cell and reproductive tract
name: Testis, germ cell and reproductive tract development
rationale: Members cover male sex determination, Sertoli/Leydig and AMH signaling, primordial germ cells and uterus/oviduct/genitalia development, distinguishing it from ovarian follicle/hormone, prostate/pancreas and placental confusables.

core: Germline and early embryo epigenetic control
name: Germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover piRNA/KRAB-ZFP/HUSH retroelement silencing, imprinting and X inactivation, sperm chromatin and maternal mRNA decay with zygotic genome activation, whereas confusables concern meiotic recombination or fertilization.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis
rationale: Members centre on myogenesis, skeletal muscle fiber differentiation, muscle cell homeostasis and diaphragm development, distinguishing it from confusables on muscle atrophy, dystroglycan glycosylation or neuromuscular junction.

core: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction, relaxation and cGMP signaling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and arterial pressure via cGMP, catecholamines, endothelin and angiotensin, whereas confusables focus on renin-angiotensin metabolism or eNOS activation.

core: Hydrogen peroxide and antioxidant vitamin metabolism
name: Thyroid hormone generation, hydrogen peroxide and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members combine peroxide-dependent thyroid hormone generation/transport and H2O2 regulation with vitamin C/E metabolism and response, distinguishing it from selenium, thyroid receptor, ROS detoxification and iron confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E and ubiquinol
name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E and ubiquinol metabolism
rationale: Members concern vitamin K metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E transport and ubiquinol/quinone synthesis, distinguishing it from vitamin D, cholesterol and ascorbate confusables.

core: Ephrin and axon guidance cytoskeletal signaling
name: Ephrin repulsion and Rho GTPase control of filopodia
rationale: Members cover ephrin signaling, growth cone collapse and DCC attraction acting through RAC1/CDC42/RHOF on filopodia and actin bundles, whereas confusables centre on netrin, SLIT-ROBO and L1 guidance.

name: TNF receptor-driven canonical and noncanonical NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 and TNFR-superfamily canonical and NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kappaB activation with linear ubiquitination, distinguishing it from deubiquitination, sumoylation and TLR-IKK recruitment confusables.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and electrical coupling
rationale: Members describe sinoatrial/atrioventricular node and His-Purkinje development, conduction regulation and gap-junction coupling, absent from confusables on myocardium growth, vasculogenesis and heart morphogenesis.

name: Leukocyte lineage identity: monocyte, neutrophil and B cell
rationale: Members are hematopoietic lineage signatures, mostly monocyte/macrophage and neutrophil identity and activation plus B cell development, distinguishing it from CSF1, dendritic-cell surface and degranulation confusables.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis, recruitment and diapedesis via formyl peptide GPCRs, distinguishing it from degranulation, respiratory burst and chemokine-production confusables.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis and interconversion
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis and interconversion
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis plus nucleoside mono/di/triphosphate interconversion, whereas confusables centre on nucleotide catabolism and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism.

name: Defensin and metal-sequestering antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members describe direct antimicrobial killing by alpha/beta defensins, metal/iron sequestration, cytolysis and mucosal defense, with defensins and metal chelation absent from all confusables.
